widget.name: uzbridge — Payme, Click, Uzum payments
widget.short_description: Payment links from a lead; paid leads move to your Paid stage automatically.
widget.description: Create a payment link right in the lead card. Customers pay with Payme, Click or Uzum Bank, the fiscal receipt is issued automatically and the lead moves to the stage you chose. Merchant keys and stages are set in the uzbridge dashboard: https://uzbridge.shokhsmee.uz
widget.tour_description: A Payment panel in the lead card: a Payme / Click / Uzum link and an SMS to the client in one click.

ui.title: Payment
ui.save_lead_first: Save the lead to create an invoice.
ui.not_connected: This account isn't connected to uzbridge. Connect it in the dashboard.
ui.no_providers: No payment methods are set up.
ui.sms_none: No approved templates — add them in uzbridge → SMS.
ui.nothing_on: Nothing is switched on in uzbridge for amoCRM: Settings → uzbridge.
ui.s_pay_hint: Which cash desks links from this amoCRM offer, one per payment system. Merchant keys are added in the uzbridge dashboard.
ui.s_bills_hint: Each payment link creates an invoice in the lead; it turns Paid once paid.
ui.s_sms_hint: SMS from the lead card, from phone numbers and in pipeline automation.
ui.s_sms_missing: No SMS gateway connected. Connect Eskiz or Playmobile in uzbridge → SMS.
ui.s_tpl_hint: Templates switched off don't appear anywhere in amoCRM: the card, the “SMS shablon” field in the uzbridge tab or the pipeline.
ui.s_auto_hint: A payment link or SMS on its own when a lead reaches a stage, right away or after a delay.
ui.s_auto_1: Leads → Set up pipeline, pick a stage and click “+ Add”.
ui.s_auto_2: Find uzbridge and pick the action: payment link, SMS, or link + SMS.
ui.s_auto_3: Choose the template and when to run it (right away or after N minutes / hours / days), then save the pipeline.
ui.dp_now: Right when the lead enters the stage
ui.dp_hint: A delayed action is dropped if the lead has left the stage by then. The link is for the lead's budget.
ui.v_hint: Write {key} in a template text; on sending it is replaced by the lead's or contact's field. Built-ins always work. Submit the Eskiz template for moderation with this {key}.
ui.s_sms_account_hint: Which gateway account this amoCRM sends SMS through.
ui.d_hint: Contracts, acts and offers from your templates: made in the lead card, numbered per template, keywords filled from the lead's fields.
ui.d_no_templates: No templates yet — make them in uzbridge → Documents.
